newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gree expects to exceed '96 profit target.
newsitem.headline: Gree expects to exceed '96 profit target.

text.p: Zhuhai Gree Electrical Appliances Inc, a major Chinese air-conditioner maker, said on Thursday it expected to exceed its 1996 net profit target of 172.40 million yuan, up from 1995's profit of 155.17 million.

Earnings growth was based on strong sales, which reached three billion yuan in 1996 against the company's projection of 2.9 billion yuan, a company spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Detailed results would not be released to the public until an audit had been completed, he said.
About 90 percent of Gree's products were sold domestically last year, with the remainder exported to Europe and Southeast Asia, the official said.
He said the company earned US$35 million in export sales in 1996, but gave no comparative figure.
Gree expects stronger profits in 1997 due to a technological upgrade in the fourth quarter of 1996, he said. He declined to give a profit forecast for 1997.
Gree, based in Zhuhai in southern Guangdong province, listed 21 million A shares in Shenzhen last November.
The company's A stock is made up of 7.84 million shares issued at one yuan per share between 1989 and 1991, and 13.16 million shares at 2.50 yuan in 1992.
The company said it had sales of 2.56 billion yuan in 1995 and 1.11 billion yuan in 1996. Sales reached 1.85 billion yuan in the first six months of 1996.
